j'ai fait un modèle mais je comprends pas bien la formule 

formula <- N3_ajuste ~
  T2M + T2M_MIN + RH2M + T2MDEW + T2MWET + PRECTOTCORR +
  PRECTOTCORR_SUM + log(ACT + 1) + log(RMAT) + log(Ratio_habitant_csps) +
  log(densite_pop) + proportion_pop_Access_MII_5km +
  proportion_pop_Use_MII_5km + moins_5km + plus_5km +
  proportion_pauvre + T2M_MAX +
  T2M_lag1 + T2M_lag2 + T2M_lag3 +
  T2M_MIN_lag1 + T2M_MIN_lag2 + T2M_MIN_lag3 +
  RH2M_lag1 + RH2M_lag2 + RH2M_lag3 +
  T2MDEW_lag1 + T2MDEW_lag2 + T2MDEW_lag3 +
  T2MWET_lag1 + T2MWET_lag2 + T2MWET_lag3 +
  PRECTOTCORR_lag1 + PRECTOTCORR_lag2 + PRECTOTCORR_lag3 +
  PRECTOTCORR_SUM_cat+T2M_Max_cat+T2M_Min_cat+T2M_cat+
  f(Numero_DS, model = "bym2", graph = H,
    hyper = list(
      phi = list(prior = "pc", param = c(0.5, 0.5)),
      prec = list(prior = "pcprec", param = c(1, 0.01))
    )) +
  f(Mois, model = "ar1",
    hyper = list(
      prec = list(prior = "pcprec", param = c(0.5, 0.1))
    )) +
  log(pop_cible)

options(inla.verbose = TRUE)  # Activer le mode verbeux

# Ajustement du modèle INLA
model <- inla(
  formula,
  family = "nbinomial",
  data = data,
  E=log(data$pop_cible),
  control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE),
  control.compute = list(dic = TRUE, cpo = TRUE, waic = TRUE)
  #control.inla = list(strategy = "adaptive", int.strategy = "eb")
)

# Affichage des résultats
summary(model)
